answer: Reputation drawdown: each identity's history is a crystal that shatters network-wide when fraud is proven, so fresh wallets inherit nothing and must rebuild trust from zero. The atlas of transaction graphs is recomputed to flag clusters sharing behavioral fingerprints, and any wallet touching a flagged cluster loses priority routing. A willow of liability trails back to the operator's registered payout address, which is throttled to one withdrawal per epoch and audited. Cost: roughly 40 hours of genuine activity and forfeited routing priority per identity burned.
